claims.summary: Binary Boolean Gamma on v variables, generators degree<=w,1 notin C_D. For any r affine forms with independent linear parts, if B=D-r>=max(2,w), some fibre of free dimension n=v-r preserves PC hardness through B. Its selector chi_b has degree<=r and survives C_D; a fibre refutation would derive chi_b through B+r. Affine elimination preserves degree-B refutability both ways and does not increase joint degree of a complete ENS source when fresh coefficients are fixed. The guaranteed deficit is n/2-B=(v/2-D)+r/2. This is a limitation of the generic selector guarantee, not an upper bound on actual fibre hardness or a rejection of specially chosen slices.
